title: Output-aware action transformation
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, let $S$ and $H$ be sets, and let $e:S\times\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$ and $r:\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}\to H$ be functions. Given a Boolean flag $o$, an optional input bit $i$, and a one-step action $a$ of a $k$-work-tape machine over the Boolean alphabet with states $S$, form an action with $k+1$ work tapes and states $H$ as follows: its input head moves right if $a$ emits a bit and stays otherwise; its first work tape is unchanged and its remaining work-tape actions are those of $a$; it emits no output; and its successor state is always present, equal to $e(q,o')$ if $a$ has successor state $q$, and to $r(o')$ otherwise, where $o'=o\lor(a\text{ emits a bit and }i\text{ is absent})$.
hypotheses_covered: action $a$ with $k$ work tapes over Boolean symbols and states $S$
